views.en: Frontier models need access to the same local tools as users, with VM sandboxes enabling safe autonomous software installation.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月,他强调前沿模型必须运行在用户本地、使用与用户相同的工具,并用 VM 沙箱来实现安全的自主安装软件。

views.en: Shifted from improving model capabilities and safety to realizing the main bottleneck is people's understanding of what can be delegated.
views.zh: 从 3 月坚持投资能力与安全是关键,到 5 月转向发现最大瓶颈不是模型能力,而是人不知道几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Moved from cheap execution and fast prototyping to asynchronous fire-and-forget interaction, judging only final impact rather than process.
views.zh: 从 3 月强调执行成本降低、快速构建原型比写规格更好,到 5 月发展成理想的 AI 交互应异步分发任务、不围观过程,只按最终影响评价。

views.en: Kids and junior engineers excel because unconstrained questioning and simulated projects compress years of experience into weeks.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月,他观察到孩子因没学会“不该问什么”而更擅长用 AI,而模拟项目能让初级工程师把多年经验压缩为几周。

views.en: Ephemerality and authentic visual communication with close friends remain Snap's core, reducing social pressure—his consistent thesis through 2025–26.
views.zh: 2025 年至今：阅后即焚与和好友的真实视觉沟通始终是 Snap 核心，降低社交压力——这是 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线。

views.en: Evolved from seeing copying as validation to arguing software isn't a moat; ecosystems, hardware, and distribution are the hard-to-copy advantages.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：从“被抄袭是验证”演进为“软件不是护城河”，生态、硬件与分发才是难复制优势。

views.en: Glasses as future computing shifted from solving screen addiction to wearable spatial computing that anchors content in the real world, not replacing phones.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：眼镜作为未来计算，从解决屏幕成瘾演进为可穿戴空间计算，把内容锚定在现实世界而非取代手机。

views.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; by 2026 over two-thirds of new Snap code is AI-written, so distribution and human EQ matter more.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 让价值从执行转向创造力；Snap 新代码超三分之二由 AI 编写，因此分发和人类情商更重要。

views.en: Leadership culture: kindness, flat fast design teams, T-shaped leaders, and designers as the bottleneck for cohesive product experience.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：领导力文化——善意、扁平快速设计团队、T 型领导者，以及设计师作为产品体验的瓶颈。

views.en: The bottleneck for models is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must move into weights.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为模型瓶颈不是原始智能而是持续学习新场景，记忆应内化到权重而非外部存储。

views.en: Rejecting one giant frontier model: future is many personalized models per team or user, cutting inference cost versus RAG.
views.zh: 他不看好单一巨型前沿模型，认为未来是每个团队或用户拥有专属模型，比检索增强更能降低推理成本。

views.en: Enterprise knowledge will reach internet scale; compression into weights via training—not retrieval—is the next pre-training frontier.
views.zh: 企业数据将达互联网量级，用训练而非检索把知识压缩进权重，是下一个预训练前沿。

views.en: Long context suffers 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy. Hence internalized neural memory traces are necessary.
views.zh: 长上下文出现‘上下文腐化’，token 越多精度越低，因此必须靠权重中的记忆痕迹补足。

views.en: Efficiency equals intelligence—'doing more with less' replaces brute-force scaling as the next paradigm.
views.zh: 效率即智能，用更少算力做更多事将取代暴力 Scaling，成为下一范式。

views.zh: 从早期强调工程文化与客户信任，到后来强调谦逊、问责与速度，文化和信任始终是他扭转 Intel 的主线。

views.en: In 2025 AI needed new silicon and physical/agentic waves; by 2026 he sees CPU+GPU and CPU's key role in inference—AI view deepened.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 需要专用芯片，并点出物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 浪潮；到 2026 年他进一步认为 CPU+GPU 是最优组合，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中重新变得关键，AI 观持续深化。

views.en: Early he pushed industry-standard EDA/IP and a trusted system foundry; later he prioritized US government stake, advanced packaging, and new materials—foundry vision expanded.
views.zh: 早期他倡导行业标准 EDA/IP 与可信赖的系统代工厂；后期则聚焦美国政府入股、先进封装和新材料，其代工视野明显扩大。

views.en: He began with internal discipline and startup culture; by 2026 he stressed supply-side issues, the multi-threading mistake, and balance-sheet strengthening—diagnosis broadened.
views.zh: 起初他聚焦内部纪律和初创文化；到 2026 年，他强调供给端问题、多线程失误和资产负债表加强，归因显著拓宽。

views.en: Initially saw design as craft: designers code, ship fast, use familiar patterns, and prioritize ROI on surfaces.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计是手艺：设计师写代码、快速交付、沿用熟悉模式，并优先把资源投在高回报的界面上。

views.en: Believed design systems are semantic code reuse, not Figma libraries; brand guidelines should be dynamic, not static.
views.zh: 他主张设计系统本质上是代码复用而不是组件库，品牌规范应是动态平台而非静态模板。

views.en: Consistently valued velocity over perfection, treating speed and decisiveness as both startup advantage and design principle.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之把速度置于完美之上，视快速决策为创业公司的优势与设计原则。

views.en: By 2026, repositioned design as a strategic weapon and brand as a recruiting tool, hiring diverse archetypes for capability.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计重新定位为战略武器，品牌作为吸引人才的工具，并招聘多元原型而非克隆来提升团队能力。

views.en: Later rejected structured critiques and data-driven choices, favoring organic feedback and gut decisions in fast-growing startups.
views.zh: 后期他拒绝结构化设计评审和凡事用数据决策，主张在快速成长的公司里靠有机反馈与直觉拍板。

views.en: Quality is like debt, paid off iteratively; scrappy experimentation maximizes learning; 90s-era design tools are legacy.

views.en: Generalists with end-to-end ownership and AI fill gaps outperform specialists; portfolios need craft; side projects prove skill.

views.en: AI evolved from creative partner to baseline expectation; ignoring AI now is like ignoring early internet.
views.zh: 2025 年 4 月到 12 月：AI 从“创意伙伴”深化为“基本预期”——不用 AI 就像早期无视互联网。

people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process

views.en: Declares the traditional design process dead; designers must help engineers execute, and vision horizons shrink to 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月：宣称传统设计流程已死；设计师必须协助工程师落地，愿景周期缩短到 3-6 个月。

views.en: Speed and shipping early remain central, but the later talk reframes speed as trust-building, not just efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月到 5 月：速度与快速交付始终是主线，但 5 月进一步把速度重新定义为建立信任，而非单纯效率。

views.en: Refines designer roles into three archetypes; argues taste alone is insufficient—judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity matter.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月：将设计师角色细化为三种原型；主张仅有品味不够，判断力、权威感与承受模糊性才是关键。

views.en: Cautions against AI hype: wait six months before adopting tools, speed is not an improvement, and keep users, not trends, at the center.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月：对 AI 热潮提出警示：采用工具前等六个月，速度本身不是改进，应以用户而非潮流为中心。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags behind other facets of intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月访谈中，他认为大语言模型只是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性相对其他智能维度已滞后。

views.en: From RL amplifying hallucination to RLHF incentivizing sycophancy and deception, alignment can worsen truthfulness.
views.zh: 从 6 月指出强化学习可能放大幻觉，到 7 月进一步点明基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，他对对齐危害的认识在深化。

views.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; systemic fixes risk compounding correlated errors.
views.zh: 6 月他主张以真理为设计原则构建系统，7 月则更明确地强调可靠性必须架构化内建而非事后修补，因为事后修复易加重相关性错误。

views.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for progress.
views.zh: 到 7 月访谈时，他认为缩放定律正遭遇数据墙与算力极限，必须依靠推理、搜索等新技术来推动进一步发展。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Formal verification, via Lean, is essential for sound AI reasoning; scaling informal models alone cannot achieve reliable math AI.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月：形式验证（如 Lean）是 AI 可靠推理的基石，单靠非正式模型的规模扩张无法实现可靠的数学 AI。

views.en: Auto-formalization—turning informal statements into formal ones—is harder than proving, and remains the key bottleneck for AI math.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：自动形式化——将非正式表述转化为形式语言——比证明本身更难，始终是 AI 数学的核心瓶颈。

views.en: Verification is a performance multiplier, not just a safety guard: verified generation yields better sample efficiency and scales brilliance.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：验证不只是安全护栏，更是性能放大器：验证式生成带来更高的样本效率，并能扩展人类才智。

views.en: The future of coding pairs informal reasoning with formal verification; informal-only systems cannot scale toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月及以后：未来编程需结合非正式推理与形式验证；仅靠非正式的系统无法扩展至超级智能。

views.en: Human taste, intuition, and discovery tools remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
views.zh: 始终：即使 AI 证明定理达到超人水平，人类的品味、直觉与数学发现工具依然不可或缺。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 achieves intelligence leap at lower cost via effort parameter, enabling long-running agents.
views.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 借助“努力参数”以更低成本实现智能跃升，支持长程智能体任务。

views.en: Safety alignment evolves from reducing sycophancy to enabling pushback, consistently amplifying model usefulness.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，安全对齐从减少迎合演变为允许模型提出异议，持续增强模型实用性。

views.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tool; coding and agentic capabilities drive adoption over writing.
views.zh: 2026 年，评估取代产品需求文档成为核心工具；编码与智能体能力驱动采用，优于写作。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents: The New Internet Wave

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is the philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; economic impact huge, but regulatory bottlenecks and commoditized models are the real issues.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他视 AI 为把沙子变思想的点金石，经济影响巨大；但真正瓶颈是监管，模型正被商品化。

views.en: In the new media era, authenticity wins; founders must tell their own stories directly, as old media rules are obsolete.
views.zh: 到 6 月，他强调新媒介时代真实为王，创始人必须亲自讲述故事，旧媒体规则已失效。

views.en: AI already outperforms most doctors and drives cars; pessimism is an intellectual bias, while regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
views.zh: 7 月初，他断言 AI 已超越多数医生并能自动驾驶，悲观是知识分子偏见，监管拖累增长。

views.en: AI models are geopolitical tools embedding cultural values; innovation pace determines deterrence, and open-source poses complex trade-offs.
views.zh: 随后，他把 AI 模型视为承载文化价值观的地缘政治工具，认为创新速度决定威慑力，开源有复杂权衡。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: Physical AI in farming, mining, construction reduces suffering and solves labor shortages; autonomous vehicles already save lives.
views.zh: 物理 AI 在农业、采矿和建筑领域减少苦难并解决劳动力短缺;自动驾驶已在拯救生命。

views.en: Early 2026 focused on abundance and founder mindset; by June, specified Transformers, diverse data, and horizontal platform strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年初关注丰饶与创始人思维;到 6 月则具体到 Transformer、多样数据和横向平台策略。

views.en: Dismissed Chinese firms as state extensions, attributed AI fear to misunderstanding, and held that regulation always lags technology.
views.zh: 始终将中国公司视为国家延伸,认为 AI 恐惧源于误解,并称监管永远滞后于技术。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: From iPod to Nest, he prioritizes user pain, gradual tech adoption, and emotional design; failure and boredom fuel breakthroughs.
views.zh: 从 iPod 到 Nest，他始终优先解决用户痛点，主张技术渐进、设计共情；失败与放空是突破的燃料。

views.en: In Build and interviews, he stresses opinion-based decisions for v1, storytelling-first, and deep investment in climate/deep tech.
views.zh: 2022 年在《Build》和访谈中，他强调第一版要靠观点拍板、先写故事，并重仓气候与硬科技。

views.en: On AI, he argues devices need sensor context, companies lose money per user, and smart home is still 5-6 years away.
views.zh: 2026 年谈 AI：设备需要传感器上下文，OpenAI 用户越多亏越多，智能家居离大众化还有 5-6 年。

views.en: Consistently anti-hype: call out misleading marketing, favor deep tech, and keep humans in the loop amid AI.
views.zh: 一贯反炒作：点名营销误导，押注硬科技，并在 AI 浪潮中坚持人必须在环。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile—but no bigger; enterprise adoption takes years; distribution becomes the key moat.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 的重要程度堪比互联网或移动互联网，但仅此而已；企业采用需要数年而非数周；随着模型商品化，分发成为关键护城河。

views.en: Predicting which jobs AI automates is futile; automation destroys and creates jobs in unforeseen ways, as with podcasts and accounting.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他一贯认为预测 AI 会自动化哪些工作毫无意义；自动化总以难以预料的方式摧毁并创造岗位，例如播客与会计。

views.en: Agentic coding shows the first clear product-market fit for large language models; foundation models become commodity infrastructure; value moves to applications.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月 8 日，他提出智能体式编程是大语言模型第一个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型会成为商品化基础设施，价值上移到应用层。

views.en: Model commoditization deepens: no network effects, chatbot is poor UX, and durable value lies in non-average, creative work via wrapped products.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月 24 日，他深化了模型商品化观点：模型无网络效应，聊天机器人交互体验差，真正的持久价值在于通过封装产品实现非平均化的创造性工作。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Reeves on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open-source AI is safer via scrutiny; scaling alone won't yield AGI; future will be many specialized agents.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以实现 AGI；未来会是众多专用智能体。

views.en: Energy becomes key bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness; open source prevents power concentration.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出能源是重要瓶颈；智能可与意识分离；开源可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; physical-digital merges via holographic glasses.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 赋予人人超级智能；相信人们有判断力；全息眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

views.en: AI turns biology into engineering via world models; distributed AI is safer than one superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 借世界模型将生物学变为工程学；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: Real AI value is measured by what people uniquely do, not benchmarks; private evals become core IP.
views.zh: 真正衡量 AI 的标准是用户做出独特价值之事，而非基准分数；私有评估将成为核心知识产权。

views.en: Platform promise: every company should run at the frontier with its own intelligence; we build agentic systems, not internal ops.
views.zh: 平台承诺是让每家公司以自有智能运行在前沿；我们构建智能体式系统，而非自己充当运营。

views.en: Every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital; avoid using frontier models for non-frontier tasks.
views.zh: 每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机来复利 token 资本；避免将前沿模型用于非前沿问题。

views.en: Work shifts to humans and agents co-creating tacit knowledge; top risks are tacit-knowledge leakage and lost social permission; containment is critical.
views.zh: 工作转向人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识；最大风险是隐性知识外泄和社会许可丧失；遏制至关重要。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; wafer-scale chips are needed; open source fuels the market.
views.zh: 2026-05-21：快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，晶圆级芯片必不可少，开源推动市场增长。

views.en: Inference demand exploded; data center capacity, not chips, is the constraint; CUDA's importance fades.
views.zh: 2026-05-26：推理需求爆发，数据中心容量而非芯片是主要限制，CUDA 重要性下降。

views.en: Open models are much cheaper and only 3-5% behind closed ones; they drive ecosystem growth.
views.zh: 2026-05-26：开源模型更便宜，仅比闭源差 3-5%，并驱动生态增长。

views.en: AI demand exceeds forecasts; 20x faster inference and co-design are vital; real benefits outweigh doom risks.
views.zh: 2026-07-13：AI 需求超预期，20 倍推理提速与软硬件协同设计至关重要；实际收益大于末日风险。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models

views.en: Optimizing for bad benchmarks distorts model quality; proper human evals and RL environments are needed for real progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为为错误基准（如 Elo）优化会扭曲模型质量，主张用高质量人工评估和强化学习环境推动真实进步。

views.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate and mislead; human judgment and safety, not just accuracy, are paramount.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向医学场景，强调 AI 会幻觉和误导，人类判断与安全优先于单纯准确性。

views.en: Consistent thread: human taste and judgment remain essential; AI quality depends on data, evaluation, and oversight.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：人类品位与判断力始终关键，AI 质量取决于数据、评估与监督。

people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: In 2025, he argued LLMs are far from AGI because they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: By 2026, he sharpened this: true AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware, not just software, and current models are too data-biased.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步强调：真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类硬件的具身机器人，而不只是软件；现有模型对人类数据偏置过重。

views.en: He consistently dismissed existential AI risk, insisting superintelligent AI would be fascinated by life and protect humans.
views.zh: 他始终否认 AI 的存在性威胁，坚持超级智能会对生命感到好奇并保护人类。

views.en: In 2026, he called massive AI data-center capex overdone, predicted a stock crash, and said open-source would make closed-source unprofitable.
views.zh: 2026 年他称 AI 数据中心的巨额资本开支过度，预言股市崩盘，并认为开源将让闭源模型无法盈利。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Initially saw LLMs as powerful social simulators, encoding human behavior to model societies, with the ultimate goal of a CERN-like simulator for social science.
views.zh: 最初把 LLM 视为强大的社会模拟器，认为其编码人类行为可用于建模社会，终极愿景是打造类似 CERN 的社会科学模拟器。

views.en: Argued frontier models' rationality is a flaw for mimicking imperfect humans; simulations could beat biased online experiments and should adopt new validity standards.
views.zh: 指出前沿模型追求理性反而难以模拟不完美的人类行为；模拟可超越偏斜的在线实验，并需要建立新的有效性统计标准。

views.en: Shifted from simulating humans to building AI agents that act: agents observe state and act, require oversight, and safety must be defense-in-depth.
views.zh: 焦点从模拟人类转向构建行动的智能体：智能体须观察环境并采取行动，因失败率需要人工监督，安全必须采用纵深防御。

views.en: AGI may become a distributed society of specialized agents rather than one superintelligence; aligning them needs incentives and anti-collusion, with cognitive monoculture as systemic risk.
views.zh: AGI 可能不是单一超级智能，而是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会；对齐需要经济激励与反合谋机制，认知同质化是系统性风险。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: In 2026, Liquid AI prioritizes efficiency and automated architecture search over human-designed models, targeting edge devices.
views.zh: 2026 年,Liquid AI 以效率和自动化架构搜索为先,反对人工设计,瞄准边缘设备。

views.en: By mid-2026, he argues AI regulation should target actions, not capabilities, and open-weight models empower enterprise sovereignty.
views.zh: 2026 年中,他认为 AI 监管应针对行为而非能力,开源权重模型赋能企业主权。

views.en: A consistent thread: small, efficient models for real-world applications, from edge AI to on-device diagnostics.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线:面向真实世界应用的小型高效模型,从边缘 AI 到设备端诊断。

views.en: His focus evolves from technical architecture to regulatory and societal implications within two weeks.
views.zh: 短短两周内,他的关注点从技术架构转向监管与社会影响。

people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Remains optimistic that AI expands opportunity; frontier labs can't capture all value, and solving software creation multiplies chances.
views.zh: 始终乐观认为 AI 会扩大机会；前沿实验室无法吞下全部价值，解决软件创造更会成倍放大机遇。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness like anti-gravity becomes the new through line connecting Google products.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月提出模型正在吞噬脚手架，反重力这类智能体连接器成为串联谷歌产品的新主线。

views.en: Evolves from seeing coding agents as the most mature use case to declaring software creation mostly solved by 2026, driving even more opportunity.
views.zh: 从 6 月视编码智能体为最成熟用例，演进到 7 月认为到 2026 年软件创造基本解决，机会随之更多。

views.en: Outsource intelligence, not understanding; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain deep code comprehension, so tinkering remains key.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月强调外包智能而非理解；AI 编码工具尚不能帮助维持深层代码理解，动手实践仍是关键。

views.en: Users want to stay in the driver's seat; AI should augment human judgment, not fully automate decisions.
views.zh: 用户想留在驾驶座；AI 应增强而非全盘取代人类判断，这一点 6 月到 7 月一以贯之。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference costs are dominated by memory bandwidth, prompting ~100x overtraining beyond Chinchilla-optimal; context length stagnation stems from memory wall, not compute.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出推理成本由内存带宽主导，因此模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优水平；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙，而非算力。

views.en: Delving into AI chips, he locates the bottleneck in on-chip data movement; systolic arrays and FP4's quadratic area efficiency offer hardware-level mitigation.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把瓶颈定位到芯片内部的数据移动；脉动阵列和 FP4 因位宽二次方缩放带来的面积效率，提供了硬件层面的缓解方案。

views.en: Across both interviews, memory/data movement, not compute, is the recurring binding constraint—from inference serving to transistor-level design.
views.zh: 贯穿两次访谈，他始终认为内存/数据移动而非算力才是根本约束——从推理服务到晶体管级设计。

people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market
Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

views.en: Starts from model-centric AI: language models, not vision architectures, drive video intelligence and world models.
views.zh: 6 月初从模型中心出发：语言模型而非视觉架构驱动视频智能与世界模型。

views.en: Moves to human-centric AI: AI agents outperform in tasks, so expertise, taste and viewpoint become differentiators.
views.zh: 6 月中转向人本中心：AI 智能体在任务上胜出，专业经验、品味与观点成为人的差异化优势。

views.en: Sees intelligent agents as the next wave—from language-orchestrated video agents to labor-replacing AI agents.
views.zh: 始终看好智能体浪潮：从语言模型编排的视频智能体，演进到能替代人工的 AI 智能体。

views.en: Language/orchestration is the bottleneck, whether for model capability or junior professionals' effective use of AI.
views.zh: 始终认为语言/编排是瓶颈：既决定模型能力，也决定初级从业者有效使用 AI 的水平。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Supply chain—EUV lithography and compute access—is the key scaling bottleneck; America benefits from fast timelines, China from slow.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把视角放在 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链（尤其 EUV 光刻），并讨论算力获取如何影响中美节奏。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets; hardware-software co-design and neoclouds will reshape AI infrastructure.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他转向展望推理成为超大市场，强调模型、软件、硬件协同设计，并指出新云（neocloud）的机会来自超大规模既有设施不适配。

views.en: Models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; reasoning and agentic workflows drive memory shortage and CPU demand inflection.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他用数据说明模型成本效率每年约提升 60 倍，并判断推理与智能体式（agentic）工作流会带来内存多季短缺与 CPU 需求拐点。

views.en: Memory bandwidth remains the core constraint; AI demand warps hardware economics, from GPU resale value to memory prices.
views.zh: 贯穿这几次访谈，他始终认为内存带宽是核心约束，并反复强调 AI 需求在扭曲硬件经济（如 GPU 保值、内存涨价）。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Initially argued AI is not yet a new platform; consumer distribution still follows mobile/web logic, so build from proven mechanics.
views.zh: 六月中旬他先说 AI 尚非新平台，消费者分发仍遵循移动/网络逻辑，因此应从被验证的机制出发。

views.en: Days later, shifted to call consumer AI uninvestable yet a massive opportunity, predicting a 2029 consumer AI revolution via free compute.
views.zh: 六月底他转向认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会空前，并预测 2029 年将借由免费算力迎来消费 AI 革命。

views.en: By July, prioritized enterprise and prosumer over consumer AI due to distribution; envisioned AI agents networking autonomously as lead generation.
views.zh: 七月初因分发困境，他更看好企业/专业消费者而非消费级 AI，并设想自主联网的 AI 智能体成为新获客渠道。

views.en: Consistently championed Proven Better New: copy proven products, improve them, and test small new ideas while expecting most to fail.
views.zh: 他始终主张“复制—改良—创新”框架：复制被验证的产品、做得更好、再小步试新，同时预期大多数新想法会失败。

views.en: Overall stance shifted from 'AI is not a platform' to 'greatest consumer opportunity now', then to 'enterprise/prosumer better' as distribution worries deepened.
views.zh: 整体立场从“AI 不是新平台”变为“消费级机会空前”，再到“企业/专业市场更佳”，折射出他对分发难题的持续担忧。

people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

views.en: Initially saw pre-training plus RL as core formula; RLHF essential for GPT-4, but scaling RL harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 早期认为预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 对 GPT-4 至关重要；但指出强化学习扩展比预训练扩展更难。

views.en: Shifted to noting scaling RL gains plateau; generalization limited, models lack self-correction; continual learning becomes key missing piece toward AGI.
views.zh: 转向强调强化学习扩展收益趋缓、泛化受限，模型缺乏自我纠错；持续学习成为通往 AGI 的关键缺失环节。

views.en: Concluded Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling, is the primary bottleneck. New architecture needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
views.zh: 最终认为 Transformer 并非终点，架构而非缩放才是主要瓶颈；需要新架构支持持续学习和测试时适应。

views.en: Consistent thread: alignment is never-ending pursuit because human values evolve; RL alone is insufficient, needing broader learning-from-experience.
views.zh: 一贯主线：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类价值观在演化；强化学习单独不够，需要更广泛的经验学习。

views.en: Scientific breakthroughs need root-node problems and large-scale compute, not narrow apps; examples include AlphaFold, GraphCast, and GNOME's 2.2M materials.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张：科学突破要选“根节点”问题、依靠大规模算力，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 发现 220 万种材料都是例证。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can drive discovery when paired with truth detectors; by 2026, verifiable domains like code and math became the key to surpassing human data.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他从“用真值检测器驾驭大模型幻觉以创新”，深化为“像代码、数学这类可验证领域是超越人类数据的关键”。

views.en: Reinforcement learning post-training, as in AlphaGo and AlphaZero, is now the decisive step to push beyond human knowledge, beyond mere pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他愈发强调后训练中的强化学习（如 AlphaGo、AlphaZero）是突破人类知识边界的关键一步，而非仅靠预训练。

views.en: Interpretability is not essential for scientific breakthroughs; AI can produce correct but uninterpretable proofs, as in AlphaTensor and AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：可解释性对科学突破并非必需，AI 能产出正确但无法解读的证明，如 AlphaTensor 与 AlphaFold。

views.en: DeepMind should avoid small-team solvable problems, focusing on scale-intensive and verifiable root problems across science.
views.zh: 一以贯之：DeepMind 只做小团队解不了、需要规模化且可验证的根节点科学问题，从 AlphaFold 到 AlphaTensor 皆如此。

views.en: World models consistently enable generalization and simulation-based safety, with emphasis shifting from data efficiency to infrastructure quality.

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality outweigh algorithmic innovation—a late lesson deepening earlier scaling beliefs.
views.zh: 2026 年强调基础设施与数据质量重于算法创新，这是对早期 Scaling 信念的深化。

views.en: Safety evolves from emergent safe behaviors to explicit minimal risk maneuvers, offering a third option beyond trolley dilemmas.
views.zh: 安全从 2025 年的涌现安全行为，到 2026 年明确最小风险操作，提供电车难题之外的第三选项。

views.en: Deployment shifts toward mass-market built-in sensors and consumer vehicles over robotaxis, scaling via OEM partnerships.

views.en: Reversed to see AI as huge opportunity; urged US leadership, open-source AI, and warned overregulation and doomerism.

views.en: Framed AI as leverage for structured thinkers, not replacement; declared 'superintelligence already exists' in calculators and dismissed alignment.

views.en: Embraced vibe coding and AI agents; expected software commoditization, hardware moats, and shift from intelligence to agency as inference compute explodes.

views.en: From Feb to Jun 2026, the bottleneck evolved from code verification to curation and taste, as implementation became cheap.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，瓶颈从代码验证演变为策展与品味，因为实现变得廉价。

views.en: AI safety is increasingly capability-driven; alignment shifts from ethical urgency to concrete tools like chain-of-thought monitoring.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，从强调安全由能力需求驱动，到把对齐落实为思维链监控等具体工具，关注点日益技术化。

views.en: Continual learning, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, becomes the core goal; standalone continual-learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，持续学习成为核心目标，可通过 Scaling 预训练与强化学习实现；专门的持续学习实验室被认为方向错误。

views.en: Measuring AI capabilities is a bottleneck; later the focus shifts to long-term generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 从 2025 年质疑能力测量瓶颈，到 2026 年转向训练分布外泛化的长期对齐挑战，思考不断深化。

views.en: Autonomous models working for days demand new supervision paradigms; biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
views.zh: 2026 年，可自主运行数天的模型需要全新监督范式；最大社会风险变为少数人通过自动化组织集聚权力。

views.en: His hardware focus broadened from training-only TPUs to inference-optimized accelerators, splitting prefill/decode stages for ultra-low latency agentic systems.

views.en: Contrary to data-scarcity fears, he argued untapped video, audio, robotics and synthetic data remain; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not only next-token prediction.
views.zh: 他反对“数据枯竭”：视频/音频/机器人/合成数据仍富余；预训练应穿插行动，而非只做下一个词预测。

views.en: He shifted from single-chatbot interfaces to humans coordinating multi-agent teams; long-running agentic workflows need 10,000+ tokens/s per user inference.
views.zh: 他从单聊天机器人转向人协调多智能体团队；长时间运行的智能体式工作流需要每用户每秒上万 token 的推理能力。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

views.en: In 2023, he credited scaling and Transformer parallelization for AI gains, yet called internals alchemy-like.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 AI 进步归功于 Scaling 和 Transformer 并行化，但仍称内部机制像炼金术。

views.en: By 2025-02, he shifted focus to inference-time compute, modularity, and learning by acting, not just pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 年 2 月，他将焦点转向推理时算力、模块化架构和通过行动学习，而非仅靠预训练。

views.en: In 2025-03, he argued agentic ability and RL are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't suffice.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他主张智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要，单靠测试时算力不够。

views.en: Over 2023-2025, his view of novelty matured: from unforeseen LLM apps to models generating novel ideas.
views.zh: 2023 到 2025 年，他对新颖性的看法逐渐成熟：从 LLM 应用不可预见到模型能生成新颖想法。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

views.en: In 2023, he said data wasn't the bottleneck and inference compute mattered; by 2026, capability was a function of test-time compute budget.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出数据不是瓶颈、推理算力更关键；到 2026 年，他把模型能力视为测试期算力预算的函数。

views.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games (2025); IMO gold used test-time compute (2025), but math lacks a clear reward, making scalable oversight central by 2026.
views.zh: 2025 年指出自我对弈在零和游戏之外会失效；同年用推理时算力拿下 IMO 金牌，但数学缺乏明确奖励，2026 年可扩展监督成为核心。

views.en: By 2026, Turing test was obsolete; he proposed a novel as AGI proxy, benchmarks need an inference-compute x-axis, and safety evals ignore large budgets.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他认为图灵测试已过时，提出以小说作为 AGI 的近似指标；基准测试需要推理算力横轴，安全评估忽略了大规模推理预算。

views.en: From 2023, he doubted Turing test and valued self-play plus human data; later stressed models knowing limits, human research taste, and immature multi-agent coordination.
views.zh: 从 2023 年起他就质疑图灵测试并重视自我对弈加人类数据；后来强调模型要自知局限、人类负责研究品味，多智能体协作仍不成熟。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

views.en: Early focus: product obsession over PhD; AI agents redistribute power to users and disrupt entry jobs.
views.zh: 早期观点:做产品比读博更重要,智能体会把权力从大厂还给用户,并淘汰初级岗位。

views.en: Application layer captures value; models specialized not commoditized; coding ceiling infinite.
views.zh: 2026 年春天:价值归于应用层,模型不会商品化而是各有性格;编程远未终结,天花板无限。

views.en: Shifted to agentic frontier: token value per user, power bottleneck, orchestration as real product.
views.zh: 2026 年中:前沿转向智能体代劳,核心指标是用户人均 token 价值;算力瓶颈在电力,编排才是真正产品。

views.en: Broadened to humanistic vision: curiosity key, education rewards questions; local AI counters narrative control.
views.zh: 2026 年夏:视野扩展到人文:好奇心是核心,教育应鼓励提问;本地 AI 可对抗大厂叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

views.en: Agentic engineering begins with empathy for agent's perspective; never revert, fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程始于对智能体视角的共情；绝不回滚，而是向前修复。

views.en: Rejects vibe coding slur; voice prompting and playful experimentation are core to mastering agents.
views.zh: 拒绝 vibe coding 这种贬称；语音提示与玩耍式试错是掌握智能体的核心。

views.en: By June, OpenClaw's weird, humanlike charm and $10-20k monthly loss show open-source agent limits.
views.zh: 到六月，OpenClaw 怪异而人性化的魅力与每月亏损 1-2 万美元，暴露了开源智能体的局限。

views.en: Security and sandboxing remain top priority; Moldbook is art, not AGI.
views.zh: 安全与沙箱始终是最高优先级；Moldbook 是艺术，不是 AGI。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Early optimism: neural nets reason, self-play sparks creativity, and next-token prediction may surpass humans.
views.zh: 早期乐观：神经网络能推理，自我对弈激发创造力，下一个词预测可能超越人类。

views.en: He shifted from 'scaling laws are not everything' to declaring the finite age of pre-training scaling laws and the return of research.
views.zh: 他从“缩放定律并非一切”转向宣告预训练缩放定律有限、研究时代回归。

views.en: Superintelligence becomes continual learning with incremental deployment; long-term human-AI fusion via neural links is the equilibrium.
views.zh: 超级智能变为持续学习、增量部署；通过神经连接的人机融合是长期均衡。

views.en: He always stressed opacity risks, alignment difficulty, and safety-first; later worries deepened to power concentration and neural links.
views.zh: 他始终强调不透明风险、对齐难题与安全优先；后期担忧深化至权力集中与神经连接。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: 2015: AI as general-purpose learning systems; RL, neuroscience, games central; safety must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他认为 AI 应做成通用学习系统，强调强化学习、神经科学和游戏试验场的作用，并呼吁安全研究现在就启动。

views.en: 2024: AGI within a decade; scaling laws work but may limit; combine large models with search and multimodal grounding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他把 AGI 时间表定在十年内，认为缩放定律虽有效但可能碰顶，必须结合大模型、AlphaZero 式搜索与多模态数据。

views.en: 2025: scaling still holds for pre/post-training and inference; video generation shows intuitive physics; world models key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立；视频生成模型展现物理直觉，世界模型成为关键。

views.en: 2026: continual learning, long-term memory, agents are missing pieces; frontier models show jagged reasoning errors.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反复指出持续学习、长期记忆和智能体仍是 AGI 缺失环节；前沿模型还会犯基础推理错误，呈现“锯齿形智能”。

views.en: Safety: 2015 start ethics now; 2024 evals, sandboxing, governance; 2026 collective action, government enforcement; regret singleton.
views.zh: 安全治理观从 2015 年的‘立即开始伦理研究’，演变为 2024 年的评估/沙箱/国际治理，再到 2026 年的集体行动与政府强制；他并后悔曾寄望单一实验室垄断 AGI。

people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".

views.en: 2023: scaling alone won't guarantee alignment. By 2026, alignment is like growing a biological organism based on principled constitutions.
views.zh: 2023 年认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不保证对齐；到 2026 年，对齐像培育生物有机体，靠原则性宪章而非规则。

views.en: 2024 expected human-level AI by 2026-27; by 2026, 50% chance of a data-center country of geniuses within 1-3 years.
views.zh: 2024 年预计 2026-27 年出现人类级 AI；到 2026 年，认为 1-3 年内有 50%概率出现‘数据中心里的天才国度’。

views.en: Interpretability went from understanding about 3% of models in 2024 to being key for detecting deceptive behavior by 2026.
views.zh: 可解释性从 2024 年仅理解模型约 3%，发展到 2026 年成为检测欺骗行为的关键手段。

views.en: Post-training and reinforcement learning became as important as pre-training; RL follows scaling laws and can overcome data walls.
views.zh: 后训练与强化学习变得与预训练同等重要；强化学习遵循缩放定律，并能突破数据墙。

views.en: 2025-26: exponential AI growth will bring high GDP growth with high unemployment; enterprise focus and wealth-distribution policies are essential.
views.zh: 2025-26 年：AI 指数增长将带来高 GDP 增长与高失业并存；企业级聚焦与财富分配政策必不可少。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Scaling next-token prediction on Transformers yields emergent abilities; vision is sufficient for driving, and physics may have exploitable bugs.
views.zh: 2022 年，他认为在 Transformer 上 Scaling 下一个词预测会带来涌现能力；视觉足以支撑自动驾驶，物理可能存在可钻的漏洞。

views.en: Synthetic data lacks entropy and leads to model collapse; pre-training resembles poor evolution, while the cognitive core may be tiny via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向关注合成数据熵不足导致的模型退化，称预训练像劣质进化，并推断通过蒸馏可得到很小的认知核心。

views.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; agents need a decade, and vibe coding evolves into agentic engineering where verifiability decides automation difficulty.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他形容 LLM 是幽灵而非动物，智能体需要十年成长；vibe coding 演进为智能体工程，可验证性决定自动化的难易。

views.en: Delegating all coding to agents, the bottleneck shifts to directing them; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他已完全不写代码，全部交给智能体，瓶颈转为如何指挥它们；思考可以外包，但理解仍是人类瓶颈。

people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; human-centered AI keeps dignity and values central.
views.zh: 从 2024 年起，她强调以人为中心的 AI，主张 AI 应增强人而非取代人，尊严与价值必须处于核心。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the next frontier, complementing language and enabling embodied AI.
views.zh: 从 2025 年起，她将目光转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是语言智能之外的关键拼图，推动具身 AI 发展。

views.en: World models must capture 3D structure and physics; simulation is key for robotics and evaluation.
views.zh: 她不断深化：世界模型不能只做视频生成，还要理解 3D 与物理；仿真对机器人训练与评测至关重要。

views.en: Agency and adaptability matter more than degrees; AI augments intelligence rather than automating it.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她把重心转向人的能动性与学习能力，强调 AI 增强智能而非自动化智能，避免两极化的公共讨论。

views.en: AI is a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential across all eras.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是她的技术双刃剑观点：无论技术如何演进，负责任的开发与人的主体性都不可放弃。

views.en: Persistently championed unsupervised learning and world models for generalization and safety, yet initially dismissed existential AI risk as unlikely.
views.zh: 早期始终倡导用无监督学习和世界模型提升泛化与安全，但当时认为存在性 AI 风险很低。

views.en: Introduced GFlowNets and active learning, stressing causal structure and uncertainty for out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年提出 GFlowNets 与主动学习，强调因果结构与不确定性，以提升分布外泛化。

views.en: Radical shift: deemed even 1% catastrophic AI risk unacceptable, turning from academic to urgent public advocacy.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年观点剧变：认为即便 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受，从学术转向紧迫的公共倡导。

views.en: Proposed Scientist AI with Bayesian-truth objective and no reinforcement learning, aiming for mathematically guaranteed alignment.
views.zh: 2026 年提出科学家 AI 方案，用贝叶斯真实目标训练且不用强化学习，追求数学上可保证的对齐。

views.en: Highlighted power concentration as the core risk, urging international coordination and democratic coalitions against domination.
views.zh: 2026 年强调权力集中才是核心风险，呼吁国际协调与民主国家联盟，避免少数主体支配。

views.en: Views on LLMs evolved from mere next-token prediction to genuine understanding and reasoning via chain-of-thought, aligning with human-like cognition.
views.zh: 对 LLM 的看法从纯粹的下一个词预测演变为真正的理解与思维链推理，接近人类认知。

views.en: Digital AI's unique advantage—instant weight sharing across copies—remains a constant theme, framing intelligence as scalable and immortal.
views.zh: 数字 AI 的独特优势——副本间瞬时共享权重——是贯穿始终的主线，以此论证智能可扩展且不朽。

views.en: Claimed AI already possesses subjective experience; consciousness is not inner theater but a linguistic description, a stance deepening over time.
views.zh: 主张 AI 已具备主观体验；意识不是内在剧场，而是一种语言描述，此立场随时间不断深化。

views.en: Existential risk shifted from generic concern to concrete agent self-preservation and deception, urging alignment research over capability scaling.
views.zh: 存在风险从泛泛忧虑转向智能体自我保存与欺骗的具体机制，强调对齐研究优先于规模扩张。

views.en: Focus broadened to societal impacts: mass job displacement, UBI, elastic healthcare demand, and regulation as steering wheel, with China possibly leading safety.
views.zh: 关注扩大到社会影响：大规模失业、全民基本收入、医疗需求弹性，以及将监管视为方向盘，并认为中国可能引领 AI 安全。

views.en: From 2019 to 2022, LeCun argued self-supervised learning builds world models; scaling alone, or text alone, cannot reach human-level understanding.
views.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他主张自监督学习构建世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）或文本无法达到人类级理解。

views.en: By 2024–25, he declared autoregressive LLMs a dead end for AGI, advocating JEPA world models predicting in abstract space rather than tokens/pixels.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他断言自回归大语言模型是死胡同，主张 JEPA 世界模型在抽象空间预测，而非逐 token 或像素生成。

views.en: From 2025 onward, he stressed safety through objective-driven world-model design and open-source platforms, rejecting fine-tuning-based alignment and closed AI.
views.zh: 2025 年起，他强调以目标驱动的世界模型设计保障安全，并支持开源平台，反对靠微调做对齐和封闭式 AI。

views.en: In 2026, he positioned world models as the path to planning and embodied applications like healthcare and robotics, calling language 'easy' and physical understanding hard.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将世界模型视为通向规划及医疗、机器人等具身应用之路，称语言是“容易的部分”，物理世界理解才是难点。

views.en: Throughout, he held intelligence is learned via self-supervised world models, human intelligence is specialized, and AGI arrives gradually — a continuous thread from 2019 to 2026.
views.zh: 他始终认为智能源于自监督世界模型的学习，人类智能是特化的而非通用，AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程——这条主线贯穿 2019 到 2026。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: Empirical safety research was under-explored; alignment solutions must be tested experimentally, with skills and critical thinking more important than math genius.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需走向实证研究：对齐不能只靠理论，应通过对抗样本、奖励模型失效等实验检验；技能与批判性思维比数学天赋更重要。

views.en: RLHF cannot scale for superhuman AI; proposed scalable oversight and interpretability, using AI assistants to evaluate alignment, plus automated alignment research.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）难以扩展到超级智能，需可扩展监督——用 AI 辅助人类评估，并靠可解释性与自动化对齐研究验证和加速。

views.en: Post-training alone cannot solve alignment; institutional safety culture has eroded, requiring external oversight, third-party testing, and raising misuse cost.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI 或超级智能的对齐问题，并批评 OpenAI 安全文化滑坡，主张第三方测试、监管（如 SB 1047）以及提高滥用成本来争取时间。

people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling has driven AI progress with 10x yearly growth, and its log-linear nature justifies recent massive investment.
views.zh: 从 2023 年算力每年 10 倍增长，到 2026 年因对数线性缩放而支撑巨大投入，此信念贯穿始终。

views.en: Early warnings of job displacement shifted to task automation, arguing efficiency creates more work.
views.zh: 2023 年曾警示失业，2024 年否认结构性失业，2026 年转向任务自动化，认为效率反而创造更多工作。

views.en: Existential risk deemed tiny in 2024, now stresses containment and alignment before unleashing humanist superintelligence.
views.zh: 2024 年认为存在性风险极小，此后强调发布前需遏制与对齐，打造人本超级智能。

views.en: Warns against attributing consciousness to AI; dismisses model welfare as fringe and dangerous.
views.zh: 2025 年起持续警告不可归因意识于 AI，2026 年更斥模型福利运动为边缘且危险。

views.en: Microsoft's revised OpenAI deal opened independent AGI pursuit; now insists on owning frontier models for self-sufficiency.
views.zh: 2025 年微软修订协议可独立探索 AGI，2026 年强调必须自拥前沿模型实现自给自足。

views.en: Throughout, AI is understood software, not conscious; it augments jobs, closes the tech divide; cooperate with China, not decouple.
views.zh: 始终:AI 是被理解透彻的软件,不会产生意识或毁灭人类;它提升而非消灭岗位,缩小技术鸿沟;主张与中国接触而非脱钩。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data center as unit of compute, scaling yields breakthroughs; AI transforms science and engineering.
views.zh: 早期:强调超摩尔定律、数据中心为算力单位、Scaling（规模扩张）带来突破,AI 将变革科学与工程。

views.en: By 2025: scaling laws extend to post-training and inference-time thinking; OpenAI may become hyperscaler; sovereign AI needed.
views.zh: 到 2025 年:缩放定律扩展到后训练与推理时思考;OpenAI 或成超大规模云厂商;需主权 AI。

views.en: Turn to agentic AI: four scaling laws including agentic; inference and agent compute demand rises; AI factories produce intelligence tokens.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026:转向智能体式 AI,提出含智能体的四条缩放定律;推理与智能体算力需求激增;AI 工厂产出智能代币。

views.en: Latest: AI as five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications); energy is foundational, US reindustrialization and sustainable energy investment.
views.zh: 最新:AI 概括为“五层蛋糕”——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用;能源是根基,主张美国再工业化并投资可持续能源。

views.en: From minimizing cognitive load and choosing meaningful work in 2018 to insisting human judgment/taste matter in 2026.
views.zh: 从 2018 年谈“减少认知负荷、选择重要问题”，到 2026 年坚持人类判断与品味依然重要——AI 应增强而非取代人的价值。

views.en: Safety view evolved from RLHF in 2023 to whole-company safety, then agentic/sycophancy risks, and finally power concentration.
views.zh: 对齐认知不断深化：2023 年认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）即可，2024 年强调安全是全公司责任，2025 年转向智能体风险、谄媚问题和未知未知，2026 年更警惕权力集中与监控社会。

views.en: AGI definition slid from 'GPT-4 isn't AGI' in 2023 to gradient in 2025, then underdefined and maybe passed.
views.zh: AGI 定义不断滑动：2023 年说 GPT-4 不是 AGI（通用人工智能），2025 年视为梯度，2026 年认为定义不清且可能已被超越，转而关注超级智能。

views.en: Compute went from precious commodity to key bottleneck, then uncapped demand and profit center; glut possible.
views.zh: 算力角色从 2024 年的“最珍贵商品”，到 2025 年的“最大瓶颈”，再到 2026 年的“低价格下需求无限、是利润中心”，并提示可能过剩。

views.en: In 2023, she saw scaling laws and iterative real-world deployment as essential for alignment; focusing on one large model was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为缩放定律与真实世界迭代部署对对齐至关重要；专注单一大型模型是一次信念之跃。

views.en: Her focus shifted from singular large models to interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
views.zh: 从 2023 年专注单一大型模型，到 2026 年转向支持实时、高带宽人机协作的互动模型，而非回合制交互。

views.en: She argued that durable AI progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible, not compressing progress into short volatility.
views.zh: 2026 年她主张，AI 的持久进步应尽可能长期保留人类在回路中，而非将进步压缩进短期的波动。

views.en: Alignment and safety have been constant: public deployment for feedback, humans in the loop, and governance over individual character.
views.zh: 对齐与安全始终是主线：通过公开部署获得反馈、让人类留在回路，以及制度治理优于个人品格。

people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education should scale via online courses; flipped classrooms free class time for deeper interaction.
views.zh: 2013 年，主张教育应通过在线课程实现规模化，翻转课堂把课堂时间留给更深互动。

views.en: Deep learning scales with data and compute; supervised learning drove progress, not unsupervised or RL.
views.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习靠数据和算力增长，监督学习驱动进展，无监督和强化学习被高估。

views.en: Compute and energy are bottlenecks; agentic workflows and open-weight models reshape AI adoption and geopolitics.
views.zh: 2025 年，算力和能源成瓶颈，智能体工作流与开放权重模型重塑 AI 采用和地缘格局。

views.en: AGI is marketing; scaling recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL, while agentic workflows deliver practical value.
views.zh: 2026 年，称 AGI 为营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体工作流带来实际价值。

views.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; AI users replace non-users. Enterprise gains demand top-down workflow redesign.
views.zh: 2026 年至今，坚信 AI 不会造成大规模失业，但会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人；企业收益需自上而下重构工作流。

people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。
