views.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: 规模扩张容易，难的是找到能缩放的方法；反向传播并不解决表示学习。

views.en: Keys were never in our hands. AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not controlled or aligned.
views.zh: 钥匙从来不在我们手里。AI 应当无需许可地分散发展，而非被人控制或对齐。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence. Next-token prediction lacks a goal and world models.
views.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心；下一个词预测缺乏目标，也不具备世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, like Oak, with open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI 需要从运行经验中学习的通用架构，例如 Oak，并具备开放式抽象。

views.en: Representation learning is the top open problem. Connectionism won, but representations remain unsolved.
views.zh: 表示学习是头号开放问题；连接主义虽已胜出，但表示问题仍未解。

views.en: From expecting faster AI hardware in 2017 to declaring compute the fundamental bottleneck; energy and infrastructure now limit progress.
views.zh: 2017 年他期待 AI 硬件更快，如今则断言算力是根本瓶颈——能源与基础设施才是限制进步的关键。

views.en: In 2019, scaling alone seemed insufficient for reasoning, needing chain of thought; by 2026, scaling laws persist and AGI is expected within years.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以获得推理能力，需要思维链；到 2026 年，缩放定律持续成立，AGI（通用人工智能）预计几年内到来。

views.en: Alignment shifted from learning human preferences to iterative deployment with safeguards; governance and oversight must scale with agent autonomy.
views.zh: 对齐理念从学习人类偏好转向带防护的迭代部署；治理与监督需要随智能体自主性而同步扩展。

views.en: By 2025-26, models evolve from language models into proactive assistants and agents; post-training and reinforcement learning reduce prompt engineering needs.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，模型从语言模型演变为主动型助手与智能体；后训练与强化学习减少了对提示工程的需求。

views.en: The core moat shifted from engineering skill to the machine that makes models; OpenAI's business becomes simple compute resale with margin.
views.zh: 核心壁垒从工程能力转向制造模型的机器；OpenAI 的商业模式变成简单转售算力并赚取差价。

views.en: Corrected scaling laws to prefer more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and algorithmic efficiency rival raw compute.
views.zh: 修正缩放定律：多训 token 比一味扩大模型更重要；数据质量与算法效率可与纯算力抗衡（2023 年 Chinchilla 修正，2024 年再强调效率百倍空间）。

views.en: Open source AI is safer through public scrutiny, empowers enterprise control, and became the cornerstone of European strategic autonomy.
views.zh: 开源 AI 从“更安全”演进为“主权基石”：2023 年强调可审查性，2025 年后转向企业自主与欧洲战略自主，避免被单一供应商锁死。

views.en: Existential risk claims lack evidence; AGI is not a final single system but a messy direction requiring practical integration.
views.zh: 对 AGI 的怀疑一以贯之：2023 年说生存风险无科学证据，2026 年明确 AGI 不是终点，而是需要物理理解和系统整合的模糊方向。

views.en: Foundation models are starting points; commoditization shifts value to customized downstream applications and enterprise-specific problem solving.
views.zh: 价值从模型层转向应用层：2024 年预测应用层获利，2026 年判断模型商品化，差异化在于定制化垂直方案与智能体式流程（含人在环验证）。

views.en: Europe has a short two-year window to build sovereign infrastructure; energy assets and ROI discipline determine whether it avoids dependency.
views.zh: 欧洲主权从“机遇”变为“窗口期”：2025 年呼吁拥抱 AI 与本地定制，2026 年强调两年内建成独立算力与能源网络，否则受制于美国科技巨头；企业采用必须满足 2 倍 ROI。

views.en: Space reusability and multiplanetary life as existential insurance; AI safety requires regulation and objective third-party oversight.
views.zh: 2021 年至 2023 年,他强调完全可重复使用火箭与多行星化是文明的‘生命保险’,同时主张 AI 安全需要监管与客观第三方仲裁。

views.en: Neuralink raises brain-computer bandwidth; AI safety hinges on truth-seeking, not forced political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
views.zh: 2024 年,他聚焦 Neuralink 提升脑机带宽,提出 AI 安全的核心是追求真相而非政治正确,并把人口崩塌视为文明最大威胁。

views.en: AI superintelligence may arrive within one to two years; 10–20% annihilation odds, 80–90% good outcomes; humanoid robots and Starship transform economics.
views.zh: 2025 年,他判断数字超级智能可能一两年内到来,毁灭概率 10%–20%、美好结局 80%–90%;人形机器人与 Starship 将重塑经济。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space-based AI data centers arrive within 36 months; China may lead AI compute; humanoid robots enable recursive manufacturing.
views.zh: 2026 年初,他提出 Scaling(规模扩张) 撞上地球电力墙,36 个月内需把数据中心送入太空;中国可能主导 AI 算力,人形机器人带来递归制造。

views.en: AI exceeds all human intelligence in about five years, creating abundance and deflation; robotaxi validates camera-only autonomy; competitors, not government, best ensure AI safety.
views.zh: 2026 年中,他预测 AI 约 5 年内超越全体人类智能,带来富足与通缩;Robotaxi 验证纯视觉自动驾驶;竞争对手间的互相监督比政府更有利于 AI 安全。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential; pre-training scaling works, yet reasoning models deliver more gains per compute.
views.zh: AI 进步呈平滑指数增长;预训练缩放定律仍有效,但推理模型在单位算力上带来更大收益(2025)。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, weak in nearby ones; generalization remains unsolved.
views.zh: 推理模型能力呈“锯齿状”:某些领域出色、邻近领域糟糕;泛化仍是未解难题(2025,2026 继续强调)。

views.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems, yet models need vast data and learn only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 到 2026 年,推理+强化学习+工具能解难题,但模型仍需海量数据,且在穷尽表层模式后才学会概念——不像人类能少样本泛化。

views.en: AI risk focus shifts from existential concerns to near-term threats like system hacking, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年明确:主要风险不是生存级 AI,而是系统入侵等近端威胁;对‘超级智能’的担忧被相对淡化。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Machine learning relies on hypothesis classes and data splits; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
views.zh: 2014 年，强调假设类与数据划分，神经网络虽无最优保证却能成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction is the path to intelligence; data is abundant; architecture matters little; AGI may come sooner.
views.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测通向智能，数据不缺，架构不重要，AGI 可能更快到来。

views.en: Safety is not automatic from scaling; bigger models are not safer; explicit training and defense layers are required.
views.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，安全不会随 Scaling 自动出现，更大模型并不更安全，需要明确训练与防御层。

views.en: Automated red teaming and AI agents outperform humans in security testing; interpretability may become a real science via AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，自动化红队与智能体在安全测试中胜过人类，可解释性可通过 AI 成为真正的科学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; attention performs gradient descent on in-context data. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估,注意力机制如同对上下文数据做梯度下降;他提出微调可能过时,动态特化将取而代之。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training. Agents are limited by reliability, not raw capability.
views.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为继预训练之后的新 Scaling(规模扩张) 轴,认为可验证奖励是关键;同时指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性,而非能力本身。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; simple RL works best, and longer agentic coherence expands feasible tasks dramatically.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他主张预训练加强化学习就可能通向 AGI(通用人工智能),最简单的 RL 方法反而最有效;智能体式任务时长从小时级延长到 30 小时会带来质变。

views.en: Models have capability overhang; orchestration and compute matter more than raw intelligence. Future work means managing agent teams.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出模型存在巨大能力剩余,编排与算力比原始智能更关键;未来人类的工作形态是管理智能体团队,而芯片供给成为主要瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as key fine-tuning, but safety is a system property; openness is crucial against corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为 RLHF 会持续作为主要微调手段，但安全是系统级属性，开放对防止企业垄断至关重要。

views.en: Post-training data quality outweighs algorithm choice; RLVR emerges as a breakthrough for reasoning beyond RLHF.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调后训练中数据质量胜过算法选择，并指出基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是超越 RLHF 的推理突破。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but yields diminishing returns; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为预训练缩放定律仍然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练和推理时扩展。

views.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese open-weight labs gain influence via permissive licenses, not just business.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出开源模型落后闭源约 6 到 9 个月，中国开放权重实验室通过宽松许可证赢得影响力，不只是商业考量。

views.en: RLVR gains may be polluted by pre-training contamination in Qwen; human-written content retains unique value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他质疑 Qwen 上 RLVR 的部分收益可能源于预训练数据污染，同时强调人类撰写内容仍有独特价值。

people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: Data is the key bottleneck and 'new code,' not oil; compute alone won't yield AGI, but post-training data becomes the binding constraint by 2023.
views.zh: 2019 年他把数据视为 AI 关键瓶颈、称其为“新代码”而非“新石油”，并认为仅靠算力无法实现 AGI；到 2023 年他进一步强调，后训练所需的数据与人类专家才是真正的约束。

views.en: Frontier progress shifts from pre-training to post-training; specialized data and fine-tuning differentiate labs, while synthetic data is useful but not a silver bullet.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他观察到前沿模型进展重心从预训练转向后训练，专用数据与微调成为差异化关键；合成数据有效但并非万能，产品设计比模型能力更制约智能体落地。

views.en: AI becomes a centralizing force and lifeblood of economies; then recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm, with agents finally working from late 2025.
views.zh: 2025 年他警示 AI 是集权化技术、将成为经济与军事命脉；2026 年他宣称递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体从 2025 年底开始真正发挥作用，缩放定律依然成立。

views.en: Safety stance deepens: from tail risks comparable to software, to data poisoning anxiety, to refusing open-source releases until models pass safety checks.
views.zh: 安全立场逐年深化：2019 年他认为 AI 尾部风险与传统软件相当；2025 年他强调数据投毒是近忧；2026 年 Meta 转向基于安全评估的选择性开源，避免发布高风险模型。

views.en: AGI timeline collapses: 'far off' in 2019 becomes 'superintelligence coming soon' by 2026, requiring labs to organize around that belief.
views.zh: 关于 AGI 的预期大幅缩短：2019 年他说 AGI 遥远，2026 年他称超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念重建组织与基础设施。

views.en: Starts with latent demand, build for the model six months ahead, and values generalist engineers; AI coding tools already boost productivity ~70%.
views.zh: 早期（2025 年底）以“潜在需求”为核心，提出为六个月后的模型而构建，重视通才工程师；AI 编程工具已让 Anthropic 工程师效率提升约 70%。

views.en: Claude Code accidentally emerges; coding virtually solved, software engineer title becomes builder; productivity per engineer grows 150–200%.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Claude Code 意外诞生；他认为编程接近被解决，“软件工程师”头衔将变为“构建者”，人均产出提升 150%至 200%。

views.en: Coding now mostly model-written; printing press analogy; generalists and safety-by-release; MCP and loops become next frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，Anthropic 约 80%代码由模型编写，他反复用印刷术类比，强调通才能力与“通过发布研究安全”，并认为 MCP 与循环是智能体下一步。

views.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; coding on phone, ROI framing; self-improving AI possible by 2028.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他聚焦智能体式工具使用带来的指数增长，提出以 ROI 而非成本衡量，甚至用手机写代码，并预计 2028 年前后可能出现自我改进的 AI。

views.en: Proactive memory agents like Claude Tag; Opus 5 reveals product overhang—delete system prompts, let models self-direct.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向“主动式+记忆”的 Claude Tag；在 Opus 5 上强调产品滞后：删除多数系统提示反而更聪明，模型可自主维护代码。

people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

views.en: Models outpace our harnesses; perpetual challenge to rediscover new capabilities and adapt workflows.
views.zh: 模型能力始终领先于我们的使用方式，需要持续重新发现新能力并调整工作流。

views.en: Shift from harness engineering and evals to designing autonomous agent loops, goals, and verification workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，关注点从工具工程与评估转向设计智能体的自主循环、目标与验证工作流。

views.en: Planning becomes iterative human-agent dialogue; fewer constraints and reasons over rules improve performance.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，规划演变为人类与智能体的持续对话，更少约束并以理由代替规则能提升性能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

views.en: Dogfooding builds empathy, product pulse, and team rapport; leaders should integrate it joyfully.
views.zh: 吃狗粮（Dogfooding）能建立同理心、掌握产品脉搏并增进团队默契，领导者应愉快地将其融入日常。

views.en: One-on-ones are for live conversations, not status updates; delegation needs trust-and-verify; kindness is a strategic tool.
views.zh: 一对一交流用于实时对话而非同步状态；委派需要信任加验证；善意是一种战略性工具。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability and growth mindset define thriving in the AI era.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性、高责任感与成长心态定义了 AI 时代的蓬勃发展。

views.en: AI may make engineers lonely and kill coding flow; pair-programming lunches and apprenticeship models preserve joy and grow talent.
views.zh: AI 可能让工程师感到孤独并扼杀编码心流；配对编程午餐和学徒模式能保留乐趣、培养人才。

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) underlies AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; pre-training scaling hits diminishing returns.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 与 LLM；预训练缩放遭遇收益递减。

views.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; giving tools lets models act as autonomous agents beyond static weights.
views.zh: 推理时算力是新的缩放轴；赋予工具能让模型以智能体方式超越静态权重行动。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but need exponentially more compute; progress requires algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；进步要靠算法创新，而非单纯扩大模型。

views.en: World models spanning language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
views.zh: 统一语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是蓝海。

views.en: Agent memory will use non-parametric file-system storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
views.zh: 智能体记忆将采用非参数文件系统式存储，而非权重更新；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力。

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Scaling laws remain alive; OpenAI stays pure AGI research. Pre-training still key; future models will automate scientific research.
views.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律没有失效；OpenAI 仍是纯 AGI 研究公司。预训练依然是核心肌肉，未来模型将自动化科学研究。

views.en: From AGI-focused research lab to concrete automation: AI interns in one year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：从专注 AGI 的研究机构走向具体自动化目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: Verification is key bottleneck; RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, not subjective ones. Human-AI collaboration still necessary.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月：验证是主要瓶颈；强化学习擅长数学、编程等客观领域，而非主观领域；人机协作仍不可或缺。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training not dead despite predictions. Evals in crisis; separate eval teams; models need compaction beyond long context.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：缩放定律仍然成立，预训练并未死亡；评测陷入危机，需独立评测团队；长上下文窗口之外还需压缩技术。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just scaling; AI augments scientists with confidence metrics.
views.zh: 2025 年:AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和经整理的数据,而非单纯 Scaling;AI 辅助科学家,并用置信指标建立信任。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for broad biomolecules; compute scarcity paradoxically helped; full interpretability unnecessary for scientific utility.
views.zh: 2025 年底:AlphaFold 3 用扩散模型处理多样化生物分子;算力稀缺反而有助成功;对科学用途不必追求完全可解释性。

views.en: AlphaFold is narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not entire cell; many mid-size wins, not scaling alone, drove progress.
views.zh: 2026 年:AlphaFold 只是特定实验的狭义预测器,而非整个细胞模型;进步来自大量中型突破,而非单独 Scaling。

views.en: Throughout: AI provides prediction and control, not understanding; this enables science in resource-limited settings.
views.zh: 始终:AI 提供预测与控制而非理解;这也让资源匮乏环境下的科研成为可能。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Questioned scaling-only assumption: common sense may need better algorithms and data, not just more compute or pre-training.
views.zh: 2023 年，她质疑纯 Scaling 路径，认为常识问题未必靠算力堆出，更需更好的算法与数据。

views.en: Shifted from data critique to data solution: synthetic data, RL during pre-training, and small models can rival frontier ones.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她从批评数据局限转向数据解法：合成数据、预训练阶段强化学习与小模型即可比肩前沿模型。

views.en: Consistent call for open, pluralistic alignment and AI for science beyond human knowledge, not just safe ChatGPT-style responses.
views.zh: 始终呼吁开放研究与多元对齐，并让 AI 超越人类已知知识服务于科学，而非止于安全对话。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human abilities like microscopes; a universal learning algorithm and video learning move toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；通用学习算法和从视频学习正迈向 AGI。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion, especially African participation, remain essential; Africa leapfrogs legacy gaps and influences AI from the start.
views.zh: 2023 到 2026 年，他一贯强调多元与包容，尤其非洲的参与；非洲跳过遗留问题，从起点影响 AI。

views.en: Shift from capability excitement to AI safety as the biggest open challenge; responsible deployment is urgent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从对能力的兴奋转向视 AI 安全为最大的开放问题，急迫呼吁负责任部署。

views.en: Human communication and informal lab collaboration matter as much as coding; research needs embracing failure.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为人际沟通与实验室非正式协作和编码同等重要，研究需拥抱失败。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics
